blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Vendor payments are released once a week, on Thursday, from the operating account. Each run pays the approved bills that fall due before the next run, so no bill is paid late and none is paid early without a reason.

Take an early-pay discount when its window closes before the next run and its annualized rate is above 12%. Pay the discounted amount inside the window. A discount whose window has closed is lost; note it for the vendor file.

Before a bill is paid, compare its vendor, amount and invoice number, letters and digits only, against every other open bill and every payment of the last 120 days, at the amount the bank cleared. A match is not paid until a person clears it.

A change to how or where a vendor is paid is verified by calling the vendor at the phone number already on file, by someone other than the person who entered the change. Until it is verified, nothing is paid to that vendor.
No vendor is paid without a signed W-9 on file. Payments to 1099 vendors are tracked for year-end reporting.
A subcontractor is paid only when a conditional lien waiver for the invoice being paid is on file. Without it, the payment is held back, however long the invoice has been due.
A bill on hold or in dispute is not paid until the hold is released in writing. A bill addressed to another HANGS entity is paid by that entity only.

Keep at least $250,000.00 in the operating account after committed payroll. Expected receipts are not cash. The Controller and the CFO approve each run over $100,000.00 before release; the batch is prepared for them and never released by its preparer.
Appendix A. Who Approves a Run

policies.title: Weekly Payment Run
policies.text: Vendor payments are released once a week, on Thursday, from the operating account. Each run pays the approved bills that fall due before the next run, so no bill is paid late and none is paid early without a reason.

policies.title: Early-Pay Discounts
policies.text: Take an early-pay discount when its window closes before the next run and its annualized rate is above 12%. Pay the discounted amount inside the window. A discount whose window has closed is lost; note it for the vendor file.

policies.title: Duplicates and Prior Payments
policies.text: Before a bill is paid, compare its vendor, amount and invoice number, letters and digits only, against every other open bill and every payment of the last 120 days, at the amount the bank cleared. A match is not paid until a person clears it.

policies.title: Vendor Bank Details
policies.text: A change to how or where a vendor is paid is verified by calling the vendor at the phone number already on file, by someone other than the person who entered the change. Until it is verified, nothing is paid to that vendor.

policies.title: W-9 and Form 1099
policies.text: No vendor is paid without a signed W-9 on file. Payments to 1099 vendors are tracked for year-end reporting.

policies.title: Subcontractor Lien Waivers
policies.text: A subcontractor is paid only when a conditional lien waiver for the invoice being paid is on file. Without it, the payment is held back, however long the invoice has been due.

policies.title: Holds and Disputes
policies.text: A bill on hold or in dispute is not paid until the hold is released in writing. A bill addressed to another HANGS entity is paid by that entity only.

policies.title: Cash and Approval
policies.text: Keep at least $250,000.00 in the operating account after committed payroll. Expected receipts are not cash. The Controller and the CFO approve each run over $100,000.00 before release; the batch is prepared for them and never released by its preparer.
